timing: Created after the immutable one-shot V17 holdout receipt and the v17.0.0 release.
scope: Reporting and reproducibility only; no model execution, threshold change, method change, judgment change, or holdout rerun.

protocol_text_discrepancy.canonical_machine_protocol: protocol_frozen_v1.json defines H2 on answerable Recall@3.
protocol_text_discrepancy.derived_prose_error: retrieval_v17_research_protocol_2026-08-07.md transcribed H2 as Recall@10 even though the frozen 20-candidate pool was not designed for unbiased Recall@10.
protocol_text_discrepancy.resolution: The immutable machine protocol remains unchanged and authoritative. This post-evaluation addendum records the discrepancy instead of silently rewriting either historical artifact.
protocol_text_discrepancy.evaluation_impact: None. Method selection and final holdout evaluation used the pool-supported Recall@3 endpoint.

H1.reason: The final selected method used Top-3 full-query cross-encoder scores and did not use conservative attribute aggregation as its decision score.
H1.exploratory_observation: Pool-conditioned false acceptance fell from 62.5% to 37.5%, but the 95% grouped-bootstrap interval for the paired difference crossed zero and the change cannot be attributed to the preregistered attribute mechanism.

H2.reason: The observed difference and its grouped-bootstrap interval are above the preregistered -3 percentage-point non-inferiority margin.

H3.reason: Weakest-attribute diagnostics were not part of the final selected decision rule, and the parser reference was Codex-assisted calibration material rather than independent human gold.
